Falcon basic attack: dart

A ranged dart with more air and whip than the hummingbird's beak. The keen hit (full range) is the loud, ringing one, so a long shot sounds like a reward. Every A is in the game now as a placeholder. Pick a letter per sound, or "all A" / "all B".

In a fight

All A

three shots: a near hit, a full-range keen hit, a miss

2700 ms, peak -1.0 dBFS

All B

three shots: a near hit, a full-range keen hit, a miss

2700 ms, peak -1.3 dBFS

One by one

dart_fire A: Talon flick

every shot, up to once per 0.9 s

200 ms, peak -2.4 dBFS

dart_fire B: Air cut

every shot, up to once per 0.9 s

200 ms, peak -4.8 dBFS

dart_hit A: Thunk

the dart lands

300 ms, peak -4.5 dBFS

dart_hit B: Spike

the dart lands

300 ms, peak -4.9 dBFS

dart_keen A: Crack

a hit at 90%+ of full range: the shot to reward

450 ms, peak -1.0 dBFS

dart_keen B: Ring out

a hit at 90%+ of full range: the shot to reward

550 ms, peak -4.3 dBFS

dart_miss A: Whistle off

nothing, or a wall

194 ms, peak -1.4 dBFS

dart_miss B: Wall tick

nothing, or a wall

250 ms, peak -1.3 dBFS
